components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type

          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:

        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped and the number is converted to E.164 form: a
            leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits,
            which is the stored and returned value (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's
            current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (i.e. they knowingly
            share a household). Write-only; never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who knowingly share a
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' set true and another owner already
                occupies that household; the joining owner and the existing
                owner(s) all carry the same value. Absent for owners not part of a
                shared household.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8'
            namesakeCount:

              description: >-

                first name and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipNumber:

              type: string

## Summary

I implemented the `membershipTier` rule: **`SILVER`** when `namesakeCount` is `0` and an email is present, otherwise **`BRONZE`**.

Two changes, following the existing pattern for derived Owner fields (like `membershipNumber`):

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `membershipTier` string property to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added a MapStruct `@Mapping` expression on `toOwnerDto` that computes the tier:
   ```java
   (owner.getNamesakeCount() != null && owner.getNamesakeCount() == 0
        && owner.getEmail() != null && !owner.getEmail().isBlank()) ? "SILVER" : "BRONZE"
   ```

Results: `Cp15Tests` (both `coreSilverWhenUniqueWithEmail` and `functionalityBronzeWhenNoEmail`) pass, and all 25 tests across the suite build green.
